description: This script automates the process of generating documentation for plugins based on changes in source files, including JSON and header files, and updates related markdown documentation and sidebars. It supports validation, incremental updates, and integrates with external scripts for converting headers and JSON outputs to markdown.

methods.name: get_plugin_from_path(file_path)
methods.description: Extracts the plugin name from a given file path based on specific directory structures.

methods.name: validate_json_changes(changed_files)
methods.description: Checks if JSON changes in 'apis/' have corresponding output files in 'tools/md_generator/json/' and reports missing plugins.

methods.name: get_plugins_to_process(changed_files)
methods.description: Determines which plugins need documentation regeneration based on the list of changed files.

methods.name: generate_docs_for_plugin(plugin_name, file_types, logfile=None)
methods.description: Generates the documentation for a specified plugin, either from header files or JSON output, depending on changed file types.

methods.name: postprocess_md()
methods.description: Performs postprocessing on generated markdown files to clean up formatting.

methods.name: update_sidebar()
methods.description: Updates the documentation sidebar by executing an external script.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main entry point that orchestrates validation, processing, documentation generation, postprocessing, and sidebar updates based on command-line arguments.
